notes.title: Our Mountain Update 1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597487/93e1274535f913df8e4961b2e759fd11ec9cb522.png

Hello September! Now it is only 1 day before launch! Today we have little updates to Our Mountain game. After the beta testing week, we got some amazing suggestions and bug reports. We want to apologize for the bugs and also say thank you very much for the reviews and recommendations.

Update 1.2 Change & Fix

 Removed Buddy's hapiness system
 Removed Apples
 Fixed Buddy's running bug (shuttering running)
 Fixed Buddy's bark (can't bark while using gamepad)
 Players can always switch to Buddy (no time limit)
